form.oneLiner: Events for what you care about
form.realStory: We started Luma to make hosting events feel as easy as making a calendar invite, and as joyful as the gathering itself. Today millions of people use Luma every month to discover and host events — from supper clubs to founder dinners to community meetups.
form.customers: Hosts running creator dinners, founder community meetups, conference side-events, supper clubs, workshops, salons
form.proof: Millions of events hosted. Discovery feed surfacing curated local events. Used by communities at YC, On Deck, South Park Commons, and most major creator scenes.

brandWorld.brandPersonality: Warm, luminous, socially magnetic — events platform that makes gathering feel joyful and effortless
brandWorld.visualDirection: A soft-light gradient world built from Luma's signature aurora palette — pink, peach, lavender, and gold blending like light through a frosted window at golden hour. Cards feel like event covers: warm, inviting, personal — not enterprise dashboards.
avoid: Dark navy or black backgrounds — this brand lives in warmth and light
Hard geometric grids or ledger-precise layouts — too cold for a social events product
Corporate sans-serif with tight tracking — clashes with the playful rounded wordmark
Monochrome or desaturated palettes — the aurora gradient IS the brand
Generic AI sparkle iconography — the 4-point star is Luma's own mark, don't dilute it
Dense data-table layouts — this is social, not SaaS
brandWorld.whyThisWorks: Luma's entire visual identity is built on soft, saturated aurora gradients that evoke warmth, anticipation, and social energy — the palette directly mirrors the emotional state of looking forward to an event. The rounded wordmark and pastel-to-warm gradient system demand a friendly, light, expressive design world that feels like the brand's own og:image come to life.
motifs: aurora gradient pools — soft radial washes of pink, peach, lavender, gold
event cover cards — photo-forward tiles with date chips and host avatars
calendar dot grids — sparse, warm-coloured day markers
4-point sparkle glyph from the Luma wordmark
brandWorld.backgroundSystem: Soft full-bleed radial aurora gradient — pink top-left bleeding into peach bottom-right, layered at low opacity over warm white; no hard geometry, no grid lines
brandWorld.deckTheme: Warm aurora light-mode deck: soft pink-to-peach radial ambient on white, event-cover cards, DM Sans, pill buttons, sparkle accents — joyful, social, unmistakably Luma
